description: A cacophony of molten mountains and lava lakes. Willy is melting from the heat, and Freddista's sweat pours down her laces. A narrow obsidian bridge crosses the boiling chasm.

bridge_of_lah.description: Obsidian planks stretching across the heat. A sign says: 'Bridge of LAAAAAAah: Say lah every 2 minutes!'

exit_south.description: Back south to the text roads of Textlandia.

exit_north.description: The giant iron doors of Creativity floating on ash clouds.

conditions.failMessage: You can't leave Willy behind! Save him from the fiery pit first.

obsidian_rubble.description: A pile of obsidian rubble on the bridge planks.

item.onCollect: You pry loose a razor-sharp, shiny Obsidian Shard from the bridge structural supports!

lah_climax.description: The center of the obsidian bridge.

dialogue.text: Willy trips on a loose obsidian plank and plunges headfirst toward the lava lake! "HELP ME EVAPORATE SAFER!" he screeches. (Hint: Stand here and execute the 'scream' command to save him!)
Fred lets out a burning starchy scream! The intense sonic energy cushions Willy, raising him safely back to the obsidian planks! "My sole is saved!" Willy gasps. Fred's vocal cords burn.
Willy adjusts his starch. "That was too close. Let's head north into Creativity immediately!"
